title: Choosing upgrades as a crew
target: How to choose between R.E.P.O. upgrades when each one is an item with its own purpose, rather than a simple number going up for everyone.
version: R.E.P.O. v0.4.0, as installed for this build (see the sources page for the exact version string)
prerequisites: An upgrade stand in the shop
A crew that will actually use it

steps.do: Read the upgrade's name before deciding who gets it.
steps.because: each upgrade carries a display name of its own (UpgradeInfo)

steps.do: Work out whether it improves the player or the gear before you carry it anywhere.
steps.because: an upgrade records whether it is a player upgrade (isPlayerUpgrade)

steps.do: Put it on the stand rather than leaving it loose in the van.
steps.because: upgrades are placed on a stand and cached with their position (CachedUpgrade)

steps.do: Give the ability-specific ones to whoever actually uses that ability.
steps.because: some upgrades change one particular ability (ItemUpgradePlayerTumbleWingsLogic)

steps.do: Agree who is taking it before the next level starts.
steps.because: an upgrade is an item somebody has to carry and apply (ItemUpgrade)

commonMistakes: Carrying an upgrade around instead of putting it on the stand.
Assuming every upgrade helps the whole crew equally.
Grabbing an ability upgrade that nobody uses.
sources: This installation of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
